description: This file is a shell script designed for self-healing and management of WiFi interfaces and components on a device. It includes functions for restarting WiFi services, monitoring WiFi queues, resetting interfaces, and performing recovery actions based on various status checks and counters. The script handles multiple WiFi bands (2G, 5G, 6G), interacts with system services, and logs status updates.

methods.name: onewifi_restart_wifi
methods.description: Restarts the OnWiFi service and logs the action.

methods.name: vap_restart
methods.description: Performs a forced restart of a specified WiFi access point or interface.

methods.name: print_wifi_2g_txprobe_cnt
methods.description: Logs the current counters for WiFi 2G probe requests and responses.

methods.name: sync_all_wifi_2g_txprobe_cnt
methods.description: Synchronizes and updates the counters for WiFi 2G probe requests and responses.

methods.name: check_wifi_2g_stuck_status
methods.description: Checks if the WiFi 2G radio is stuck and performs reinitialization if needed.

methods.name: print_wifi_5g_txprobe_cnt
methods.description: Logs the current counters for WiFi 5G probe requests and responses.

methods.name: sync_all_wifi_5g_txprobe_cnt
methods.description: Synchronizes and updates the counters for WiFi 5G probe requests and responses.

methods.name: check_wifi_5g_stuck_status
methods.description: Checks if the WiFi 5G radio is stuck and performs reinitialization if needed.

methods.name: check_bss_queue_full
methods.description: Checks if the BSS queue is full, indicating potential issues with WiFi traffic.

methods.name: wave_driver_restart
methods.description: Restarts the wave driver for the 5G private SSID to recover from faults.

methods.name: check_bss_queue_one_min
methods.description: Periodically checks the BSS queue status over a minute.
